summary:
Batch A quick-fix verification — All 9 items (a1..a9) PASS on the preview URL against seeded data. (a1) /activity-logs Description cell has NO 'truncate' class — renders full text with class 'whitespace-pre-wrap break-words' via data-testid=log-desc-<id> (20 rows validated). (a2) ManageOrders Edit dialog: data-testid=edit-special-instructions is a <TEXTAREA>; existing DB newlines round-trip intact and pressing Enter inserts 
 (verified round-trip 'Line1
Line2 next line
Line3...

APPENDED_LINE'). (a3) ManageOrders shows delivery date/time AND 'Booked: 02 Aug 2026' via data-testid=booking-date-<order.id> on all 3 order rows. (a4) KOT print HTML for order 834883 (petpooja_bill_numbers=['PP-TEST-1002','PP-TEST-1001']) contains 'PETPOOJA BILLING' block with 'Outlet: Test Outlet' and 'Bill No: PP-TEST-1002, PP-TEST-1001'. (a5) /new-order data-testid=customer-name-input auto-converts 'jOhN doE' → 'John Doe' as user types. (a6) /customers table shows 'Age' column header and Birthday cells formatted 'DD Month YYYY' (via formatBirthday). (a7) /deleted-orders shows Badge with data-testid=deleted-stage-<order_number> value 'hold' for seeded deleted order 633797, and data-testid=deleted-export-btn present. (a8) /customers data-testid=customer-sort, customer-gender-filter, customer-age-min, customer-age-max all present (JSX inspection shows sort options include Default, Pending High->Low / Low->High, Total Spent H->L / L->H, Name). (a9) Excel/export buttons present & clickable on /manage-orders (Excel), /hold-orders (hold-export-btn), /pending-orders (pending-export-btn), /credit-orders (credit-export-btn), /deleted-orders (deleted-export-btn), /customers (Export Excel). Backend regression: /api/orders/manage returns 200 sorted delivery_date DESC (verified), /orders/hold /pending /credit /deleted all return 200.

issues: From/To Date default to today which HIDES all future-dated orders on first paint. New users with only future orders will see 'No orders found' until they click Clear Dates. Consider defaulting From=today and To=today+14 (or empty) so future orders are visible by default.

critical_code_review_comments: ManageOrders.js remains at ~2975 lines — Edit Order dialog + KOT builders + Excel exporter + Add Delivery wizard could be split into standalone modules for maintainability.

toSentenceCase in /app/frontend/src/utils/formatters.js lower-cases the rest of each word. For legitimate names like 'McDonald', 'D'Souza', 'MoNa LiSa' the user-typed capitalisation of interior letters is lost. Acceptable for the requested behaviour but flag if users complain.
ManageOrders default From/To=localToday auto-filter can cause data invisibility for future-dated bookings — consider a broader default window or an obvious 'Showing today only' hint.
formatBirthday returns '-' for empty which is nice, but the Age column shows '' (empty string) when birthday is null — consider dash for consistency with Birthday column.
